Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Actuarial Services, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Actuarial Services, LLC provides professional actuarial and appraisal services to a variety of clients, including insurance companies, financial institutions, and corporate entities. Our operations are primarily focused on delivering high-quality evaluations, risk assessments, and consulting services grounded in established methodologies and rigorous data verification processes. We prioritize compliance with regulatory standards and employ comprehensive data security measures to protect client information. Our team of experienced professionals conducts regular audits and maintains internal controls to ensure the integrity and accuracy of our financial reporting. We are committed to ongoing education and adherence to industry best practices, enabling us to effectively manage and mitigate risks associated with valuation disputes and professional liability.
